scope: Bounded review of twelve unresolved company records and three Franklin social-next25 flags. No discovery or production changes.
criteria: Companies must substantively develop relevant technology of their own, including original co-developed or OSS-based technology. Client-only implementations, generic integration, resale and support do not qualify merely because custom code is written. No patent, exclusivity, multi-customer or standalone-commercial-product requirement.
